[Part 11] Optional Computation of Net Earnings From Self-Employment
(See “Who Can Use Schedule SE”)

Generally, this part may be used only if you meet any of the following tests:

A. Your gross farm income (Schedule F (Form 1040), line 12) was not more than $2,400; or

B_ Your gross farm income (Schedule F (Form 1040), line 12) was more than $2,400 and your net farm profits (Schedule
F (Form 1040), line 39) were less than $1,600; or

C Your net nonfarm profits (Schedule C (Form 1040), line 33) were less than $1,600 and also less than two-thirds (74)

of your gross nonfarm income (Schedule C (Form 1040), line 5)
